Minam.directions: Use Minam Station boat launch at Highway 82. Do not route to the separate upstream campground. Arrange the remote takeout shuttle before launching.

Thirtymile Launch.sourceName: Oregon State Marine Board and managing-agency access guidance
Thirtymile Launch.directions: Use Armstrong Road and the designated riverside parking area. BLM closes vehicle access December 15–March 31; wet weather can make the road impassable. High clearance and suitable tires are recommended, with 4WD for trailers.
Thirtymile Launch.note: BLM documents a primitive ramp upstream of Thirtymile Creek. OSMB supplies an approximate launch-facility coordinate. No exact water-edge or bank claim is made.
